About

I’m Avika, an Industrial Designer and student at NID Andhra Pradesh.

I’m a fourth-year B.Des. Industrial Design student at NID Andhra Pradesh, graduating in 2027. My approach combines research, hands-on experimentation, material exploration and iterative prototyping.

I enjoy exploring how form, materials, ergonomics and detailing can transform an idea into a meaningful product.
